pay_detail: Salary plus room and board. The pay rate is not stated.
duration: 2026 plan: paid training May 26 to June 1, then counselor sessions June 2 to July 30 (Camp Corral July 5 to 10)
name: 4-H Memorial Camp Junior Counselor
org: Illinois 4-H Memorial Camp, University of Illinois Extension
city: Monticello, IL (about 30 miles southwest of Champaign)
what_you_do: Junior counselors live at a summer camp near Allerton Park and help run camp sessions for youth. All camp staff get a week of paid training first.
who_can_apply: Junior counselors are 16 to 17 years old. Applicants need three written references from people who are not close relatives.
deadline_text: The page says applications open in December and stay open until positions are filled. The dates listed on the page are for summer 2026, so 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Complete the camp job application (opens in December) and have three references fill out the reference form. Contact Andy Davis, Camp Director, at (217) 333-3955 or ardavis1@illinois.edu.
notes: Staff live on site during camp weeks. Program staff and senior counselors must be 18 or older. Illinois work permit rules were not checked.
